lexicon.name: Checkout workshop
lexicon.description: A small, illustrative checkout model for trying the canvas. Follow an Order through its lines and price calculation, then attach questions, sketches, or interface examples. The source is a local teaching fixture, not a production checkout.

context.name: Ordering
context.description: Collect purchase quantities and calculate an order total.

concept.name: Order
concept.description: A purchase containing the lines whose prices contribute to its total.
concept.annotation: An order must contain at least one line before its total is calculated.
concept.code-link: The total function checks that the order has a line before summing prices.

concept.name: Order Line
concept.description: A product price and quantity purchased together.
concept.code-link: The type carries a unit price and quantity.

concept.name: Order Total
concept.description: The sum of every line's unit price multiplied by quantity. Taxes and discounts are outside this example.
concept.code-link: The total function produces this number.

relationship.name: contains
relationship.description: The Order carries its lines in the lines property.
relationship.code-link: The lines property connects the Order to OrderLine values.

relationship.name: contributes to
relationship.description: The total calculation sums the extended price of each line.
relationship.code-link: The reduce callback adds each price multiplied by quantity.
